answer: Gate influence behind earned reputation, not account count, so a sybil horde of empty shells has no ivory tower to climb. Each agent wins weight only as honest peers gradually vouch for it across many epochs, the trust growing like a vine that no attacker can counterfeit overnight. The honest form a deep ocean of accumulated history, while cloned accounts drift on the surface with no anchor, ignored by consensus because they never paid the cost of real, attested work.
